name: Applause from an empty hall
text: Someone is clapping in the dark stalls, slow and steady, as if the show has just ended. Do you take a bow, or does it shake you?

name: A script with your name
text: A script lies open on a chair. Your name is in the cast list, and tonight's date is on the cover.

name: A cold hand on the shoulder
text: A hand rests on your shoulder. It is very cold, and there is no one behind you.

name: A song from the walls
text: A woman's voice sings through the walls, an old cai luong air. It wants you to listen to the end.

name: Your reflection is late
text: In the dressing-room mirror your reflection moves a moment after you do. It is holding something out.

name: Dust sheets that breathe
text: The dust sheets over the old seats rise and fall, as if something beneath them breathes.

name: A stuck locker
text: A locker is jammed shut. Something inside rattles when you pull at the door.

name: The interval bell
text: The interval bell rings and rings. Every door slams at once; you must move before they lock.

name: A portrait that turns
text: A portrait of a forgotten singer slowly turns its eyes to follow you across the room.

name: Rain on the stage
text: Rain falls on the stage, indoors, from nowhere. The boards are slick under your feet.

name: A voice gives you your line
text: A voice from the prompt box whispers your line. If you say it right, the house may reward you.

name: The counterweights shift
text: The counterweights groan and start to drop. Someone has to hold the rope.

name: A falling sandbag
text: A rope creaks overhead. A sandbag is coming down.

name: The floor gives way
text: The old boards crack under your weight.

name: A snapped wire
text: A lighting wire snaps and whips across the room.

name: Smoke from the wings
text: Thick smoke pours from the wings, and in it you hear your name.

name: A falling spotlight
text: A spotlight tears loose from the rig above you.

name: A loose hook
text: A loose scenery hook swings out of the dark.
